pairs.question: Sed adversus Hannibalem ducem quis melius quam Africani frater crearetur, cum vincere Poenos opus Scipionum esset?
pairs.answer: Creatur igitur consul Lucius Scipio, eique datur legatus frater Africanus.
pairs.derivation: Author poses a rhetorical question (who better to elect against Hannibal than Africanus's brother, since defeating the Carthaginians was the Scipios' work?) and answers it himself. Answer taken to its first full stop: 'Creatur igitur consul Lucius Scipio, eique datur legatus frater Africanus' — the operative answer (Lucius Scipio elected, with Africanus as legate). Cut before 'ut intellegeret Antiochus...', which elaborates the purpose rather than answering.
